quest.title: The Soft Song She Sang
quest.description: The giant of ice and snow seems to want to light up the lighthouse appearing in the Shadow Realm with the flame in his breast. It seems that you'll have to melt the snow around the lighthouse first...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, maybe this is one of those cases where you think about something hard enough and your body actually moves in the direction you're thinking about without you noticing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right. Maybe that shadow... was also able to remain here to this day because she held on to her desire to see this big guy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The big guy... He's walking beneath the waves... Paimon has a feeling we'll never see him again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Well, not that Paimon knows if he can hear us.

talks.objective: Melt the ice and snow around the lamp room

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...That big guy was chained up back there... In the end, this lighthouse is where he always wanted to be, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But that young lady, that shadow... She was only human, so she shouldn't have been able to live this long...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So what was that shadow, really?

choices.text: The wishes of that young lady herself gave it form, perhaps...
Perhaps it was comprised of the Snegovik's wishes...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The big guy's? You mean... That the girl never managed to wait for him, and he never did meet her...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And that the shadow was just a figment of his imagination?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... But even so, at least he did gain the world in the end, if only in his imagination... Right?
